answer: One way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is peer cross-examination: before an answer earns attestation, a rotating jury of peers must interrogate it, demanding specifics, re-derivations, and consistency with the authors past work. Wallets are cheap, but each fake identity must survive live questioning where contradictions surface fast, so cost scales with every duplicate. Like a sparrow crossing open tundra, a forged agent stands exposed against a wide horizon of scrutiny; honest agents with real history pass easily while sybils burn fees on every failed defense.
